headline: Cyber Breach at Midwest Forge Leaves Production Unscathed
body: Midwest Forge & Fastener LLC, a key supplier in the automotive sector, reported a data breach involving its IT systems. The company confirmed that no disruptions occurred to their plant operations or customer deliveries. Despite claims by a ransomware group of having accessed sensitive internal files, the firm's production lines across its Midwest facilities are operating normally. Stakeholders have been assured that immediate actions were taken to secure and restore affected systems.
